claim: Lemma 4.1 / Theorem 4.4 --- cut structure cannot orient a process; the medium can

checks.check: Lemma 4.1: chain and reversal commit identical boundary
checks.detail: 3 chains; total boundary, cut count and residue multiset all invariant under reversal. 0 violation(s). => no intrinsic predicate can orient a process (Cor. 4.2)

checks.check: Cor. 4.2: no intrinsic residue statistic distinguishes C from C^R
checks.detail: 6 candidate statistics x 3 chains = 18 tests; 0 discriminated. Any non-zero count would refute Cor. 4.2.

checks.check: NEGATIVE CONTROL: unbiased medium refuses to orient
checks.detail: uniform occupancy across all identities -> delta = 0 exactly for all 3 chains; every verdict UNDIRECTED. Without this, Thm 4.4(c) is an unreachable third case.

checks.check: NEGATIVE CONTROL: orient() raises Refusal on an unbiased medium

refusals.subject: alanine transaminase
refusals.reason: |delta| = 0.0000e+00 <= floor 3.7000e-04: the medium does not favour either direction by an amount the receiver can resolve

checks.check: NEGATIVE CONTROL: bias exceeds the floor with a margin (>2x)
checks.detail: min delta/floor = 9.20. Asserting merely delta != 0 would pass on noise; Sec. 5.3 item 3 requires a margin, after an earlier suite of ours passed on a self-comparison.

checks.check: Cor. 4.5: the SAME chain runs opposite ways in two media
checks.detail: identical chain and identical Rhea identifier; only the medium differs. This is the AlaA case (P0A959 vs human ALT1): the shared identifier is correct because reaction identity is a property of the chain and direction is not.

checks.check: delta is antisymmetric under reversal, for all weight fns
checks.detail: 12 combinations; 0 violation(s). This is the asymmetry Lemma 4.1 showed the chain itself cannot supply.

checks.check: Thm 4.4: trichotomy is exhaustive and mutually exclusive
checks.detail: 19-point two-sided sweep (deplete product / deplete reactant); cases reached: {'forward': 9, 'reverse': 9, 'undirected': 1}; 0 point(s) where the three conditions were not exactly-one-true. All three cases must be REACHED or the trichotomy is a dichotomy.

checks.check: saturating one product cannot reverse a chain (bounded by log 2)
checks.detail: L-glutamate at mu=1e30: delta/floor -> -0.6931, bound = -log(2) = -0.6931; verdict undirected. Reversal requires depleting a reactant, not flooding a product --- an asymmetry of eq. (1) worth stating.
